summary: Batch delete multiple ASCET components in a single ToolAPI session
preconditions: ASCET ToolAPI session must be available.
Live ASCET access must run through the serial executor.
Target ASCET path must resolve to the expected object kind.

examples.command: AscetBridge.exe batch delete_component See executable usage.

pitfalls: Live ASCET ToolAPI access is serial-only.
Run readback and verify after successful writes.
Confirm the live target before destructive operations.
